title: Monkey dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffcf6b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b06a1a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- dance floor swirls -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#4a2f6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='24' ry='4' fill='#6b44a0'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M70 70 Q88 66 86 48 Q84 36 72 40' fill='none' stroke='#c47a2e' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 70 Q88 66 86 48 Q84 36 72 40' fill='none' stroke='#e09a4a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M42 74 Q34 84 28 86' stroke='#c47a2e' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M58 74 Q66 82 72 80' stroke='#c47a2e' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='87' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#8a4f1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='81' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#8a4f1a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='17' ry='18' fill='#c47a2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#f0c98a'/>
  <!-- arms raised dancing -->
  <path d='M36 50 Q24 40 20 28' stroke='#c47a2e' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M64 50 Q76 38 82 26' stroke='#c47a2e' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='19' cy='26' r='5' fill='#8a4f1a'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='24' r='5' fill='#8a4f1a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='16' fill='#c47a2e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='30' r='6' fill='#c47a2e'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='30' r='6' fill='#c47a2e'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='30' r='3' fill='#f0c98a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='30' r='3' fill='#f0c98a'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#f7d9a8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='29' r='2.5' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='29' r='2.5' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='28' r='1' fill='#fff5e0'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='28' r='1' fill='#fff5e0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 37 Q50 43 56 37' fill='none' stroke='#3a2410' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#a05a20'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ffd76b'>
    <ellipse cx='14' cy='14' rx='3' ry='2.2'/>
    <rect x='16' y='4' width='1.5' height='10'/>
    <ellipse cx='88' cy='12' rx='3' ry='2.2'/>
    <rect x='90' y='2' width='1.5' height='10'/>
  </g>
</svg>
